params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"
MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY lastModifiedDateTime DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.id = D.id

WHEN MATCHED AND (
  T.lastModifiedDateTime IS NULL OR D.lastModifiedDateTime > T.lastModifiedDateTime
) THEN
UPDATE SET
  T.etag__                          = D.etag__,
  T.code                            = D.code,
  T.displayName                     = D.displayName,
  T.dueDateCalculation              = D.dueDateCalculation,
  T.discountDateCalculation         = D.discountDateCalculation,
  T.discountPercent                 = D.discountPercent,
  T.calculateDiscountOnCreditMemos = D.calculateDiscountOnCreditMemos,
  T.lastModifiedDateTime            = D.lastModifiedDateTime

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (
  etag__,
  id,
  code,
  displayName,
  dueDateCalculation,
  discountDateCalculation,
  discountPercent,
  calculateDiscountOnCreditMemos,
  lastModifiedDateTime
)
VALUES (
  D.etag__,
  D.id,
  D.code,
  D.displayName,
  D.dueDateCalculation,
  D.discountDateCalculation,
  D.discountPercent,
  D.calculateDiscountOnCreditMemos,
  D.lastModifiedDateTime
)
"
